title: 第5章 百兽阁第6章 灵犬阿泰
slug: 青铜古舟第802章你惹上事了
content_zh:
或许是午饭时感受到主家宽厚，小丫头脸上的怯懦淡去不少，多了几分灵动。
“静儿，我闭目养神多久了？”
沈算起身温和发问。
“回少爷，距自奴婢过来，约莫一柱香了。”
陈静恭敬回答。
“嗯。”
沈算点头，对熟练泡茶的陈静说：“以后在旁伺候，无需一直站着。
可在附近坐着歇息，或看看书。
别让少爷我成了扒皮地主。”
“呵呵，”
陈静掩嘴轻笑，“少爷才不是扒皮地主，是好人，是好少爷！”
“哈哈，这就对了！
多笑笑才好，不然府中沉闷的很。”
沈算心情为之一松。
“少爷，您若觉得闷，可以养只灵犬解闷，我听学子说，灵犬不止能护院，还能镇邪祟。”
“这倒是个好主意，那静儿可知这附近可有店铺卖灵犬，远了少爷这身体可去不了。”
“回少爷，奴婢知道，隔一家店铺，就有一家‘百兽阁’，专卖驯好的灵兽，也收猎人从落霞山脉捕来的幼崽和蛋呢。”
陈静眼睛一亮。
“哦？你对内城很熟？”
沈算有些惊讶，他可是知道，外城之人想进内城可不容易。

“嗯！”
陈静用力点头说：“学堂的老先生曾带奴婢入内城采买过几次，说是让奴婢开开眼界，将来也好寻个好主家。
钟叔招人时，就是老先生引我和娘亲去的。”
“原来如此，”
沈算若有所思：“看来这位老先生，是位古道热肠之人。”
“少爷，老先生人可好了！
又和善，懂得又多！
我和娘在翁城……”
陈静打开了话匣子。
沈算静静听着，手指无意识地摩挲着茶杯边缘，心中对那位“知识渊博”
、“和善”
的老先生，悄然升起了一丝浓厚的兴趣。
“走，咱们去买灵犬。”
兴致一起，沈算将杯中茶一饮而尽，招呼陈静跟上，抬步便往外走。
正在街上指挥工人装修门面的钟宇，瞥见沈算带着钟广和陈静走出府门，不由问道：“少爷，您这是？”
“哦，去隔壁的百兽阁买只灵犬回来养养。”
沈算回道。
钟宇闻言一笑，赞同道：“府中确实该添只灵犬了。
content_en:
Perhaps because she felt the host's generosity during lunch, the timidity on the little girl's face faded a lot, and she became a little more agile.
"Jing'er, how long have I closed my eyes and meditated?"
Shen Suan stood up and asked gently.
"Back to you, young master, it's about a stick of incense since I came here."
Chen Jing answered respectfully.
"Yeah."
Shen Suan nodded and said to Chen Jing, who was skilled in making tea: "I will wait on you from now on, so there is no need to stand all the time.
You can sit and relax nearby, or read a book.
Don't let me, young master, become a landowner. "
"Hehe,"
Chen Jing covered her mouth and chuckled, "The young master is not a slanderous landlord, but a good person and a good young master!"
"Haha, that's right!
It’s better to smile more, otherwise the house will be very dull. "
Shen Suan felt relieved.
"Master, if you feel bored, you can raise a spiritual dog to relieve your boredom. I heard from students that spiritual dogs can not only protect the courtyard, but also suppress evil spirits."
"That's a good idea. Does Jing'er know if there is a shop selling spirit dogs nearby? The young master won't be able to go there with his body."
"Back to the young master, this slave knows that there is a 'Hundred Beasts Pavilion' just one store away, which specializes in tamed spiritual beasts and also collects cubs and eggs caught by hunters from the Luoxia Mountains."
Chen Jing's eyes lit up.
"Oh? Are you familiar with the inner city?"
Shen Suan was a little surprised, but he knew that it was not easy for people from the outer city to enter the inner city.
"Yeah!"
Chen Jing nodded vigorously and said: "The old gentleman from the school has taken the slave to the inner city several times to buy things. He said that it opened the slave's horizons and helped him find a good master in the future.
When Uncle Zhong was recruiting people, it was the old man who led my mother and me there. "
"That's it,"
Shen Suan thought thoughtfully: "It seems that this old gentleman is a man of ancient ways and a warm heart."
"Master, the old gentleman is so kind!
So kind and knowledgeable!
My mother and I are in Wengcheng..."
Chen Jing opened up the conversation.
Shen Suan listened quietly, his fingers unconsciously stroking the edge of the teacup, and he felt a deep appreciation for the "knowledgeable" person in his heart.
, "kindness"
The old gentleman quietly became interested.
"Let's go buy a spirit dog."
In high spirits, Shen Suan drank the tea in the cup in one gulp, asked Chen Jing to follow him, and walked out.
Zhong Yu, who was directing workers to decorate the facade on the street, saw Shen Suan leading Zhong Guang and Chen Jing out of the house and couldn't help asking: "Master, what are you doing?"
"Oh, go to the Beast Pavilion next door to buy a spirit dog and raise it."
Shen Suan replied.
Zhong Yu smiled when he heard this and agreed: "It's really time to add a spirit dog to the house.
